title: Your evidence and your next experience

steps.title: Start with the work
steps.body: Open a skill to see supporting work, uncertainty, and separate statements from you, peers, and leads. Levels are advisory estimates.

steps.title: Choose a direction
steps.body: Growth lets you choose up to three focus skills and save accessible project opportunities. Saving never assigns a task.

steps.title: Find someone to learn with
steps.body: Team coverage uses shared evidence from a selected project. No evidence means unknown, and availability needs a conversation.

steps.title: One shared language
steps.body: The Library explains concepts and aliases. Supported new concepts can appear automatically. Admins can inspect and reverse consolidations while preserving the original records.
